title: CS2 World Bundle instance record
description: One line of instances.jsonl. The file is JSON Lines: one complete JSON object per line, no enclosing array, so a huge city streams. This schema validates a single line.

id.description: Producer-local stable identifier of this instance (the ECS entity index). Unique within the bundle. Present so sub-objects can reference their owner.

parent.description: The 'id' of the owning instance when this record came from an owner's SubObject buffer (a street tree on a road, a prop on a lot, a wing of a building). Absent for free-standing instances. 'pos'/'rot' are already baked to world space either way.

kind.description: Coarse class, for consumers that treat foliage or decals differently. Closed set in schema 1.

pos.description: World position in bundle-frame metres (left-handed, X=east, Y=up, Z=north).

rot.description: World rotation as a unit quaternion [x, y, z, w] in the bundle frame.

attrs.description: Semantic attributes. Free-form: a consumer must ignore keys it does not know, and must not require any key to be present. The documented keys below are the ones the producer emits when available.

elevation.description: Terrain elevation under the instance, in metres.

height.description: True height in metres, measured from the mesh bounds. Metadata attributes never override this.

assetId.description: Filesystem-safe: ASCII alphanumerics, dot, underscore and hyphen; must start with an alphanumeric.
